# FILEforge

![Github](https://img.shields.io/badge/github-repo-blue?logo=github)
![Python](https://img.shields.io/badge/Python-3.13-blue?logo=python)
![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-green)
![CustomTkinter](https://img.shields.io/badge/CustomTkinter-5.2.2-blue.svg?logo=data:image/svg+xml;base64,)

This is a Free Python Office App that let's you do OCR Layers and archive formats for PDFs and a File system auditor.

## Roadmap to 1.0.0:
- Settings Menu Complete
  - Default Paths for files and directories
  - Default file properties
  - Window Scale
  - Product key location
- Server Backend Complete
  - Product Key Verification
  - Downloading server
- Custom Installation Executable
- Custom Updater
- Main Menu
- All Issues closed

## Possible Future Ideas
- Multiple systems and bits
- Extra Apps
- Rebranding
